statement: The system shall allow each team to manage its own budget.
The system shall enable the IFA to monitor and control the financial balance to ensure proper management.
The system shall allow the IFA to conduct audits and set regulatory policies.
The system shall alert stakeholders of policy violations.
The system shall allow favorite administrative users to view various transactions.
The system shall allow all users, including guests, to view final grain data.
The system shall enable the definition of policies for game scheduling.
The system shall provide guidance on allocating referees to games based on defined policies.
The system shall allow referees to set their preferences.
The system shall facilitate the definition of referee assignment policies and automatically assign referees to games based on those policies.
The system shall allow manual adjustments to the game schedule.
The system shall require IFA representative confirmation for schedule changes.
The system shall allow the specification of budget policies.
The system shall allow referees to update game information in real time.
The system shall ensure that referees and official channels are the sole sources of game data.
The system shall send push email notifications to fans.
The system shall support concurrent access by at least 50,000 users with fast response times.
The system shall provide reasonable response time for user interactions.
The system shall be highly responsive and operate efficiently in real time.
The system shall encrypt budget data to prevent unauthorized leakage.
The system shall comply with local regulations and legal requirements in different regions.
The system shall maintain all historical archives indefinitely.
The system shall allow the IFA to define leagues, seasons, appoint or register referees, and set budget and scheduling policies.
The system shall support a team registration process requiring valid documents and IFA approval.
The system shall allow team managers and administrators to access data for offline analysis.
The system shall provide different user interfaces tailored to the needs of different stakeholders.
The system shall be a unified system with a centralized database.
The system shall allow fans to register for specific information and receive push notifications.
The system shall allow the definition of configurable parameters.
The system shall provide a web-based application for teams and IFA administrative users.
The system shall provide a mobile application for referees and fans.
The system shall support a team registration process with document submission and IFA approval.
The system shall support a referee registration process with IFA appointment.
The system shall support a player registration process managed by team administration.
